self_review_findings.finding: request_kind was missing from the first V19 context fingerprint draft
self_review_findings.impact: V5 evidence had already established that request_kind changes planner/routing semantics; excluding it would leave an empty-input context collision between request kinds
self_review_findings.resolution: response_context_fingerprint now takes request_kind explicitly and hashes it

self_review_findings.finding: the first V19 draft only compared context for ordinary Responses turns, not compaction continuation
self_review_findings.impact: empty-input compaction could still continue a legacy/stale Notion thread because () is a valid prefix of every history
self_review_findings.resolution: compaction continuation now additionally requires a persisted context fingerprint equal to the current compaction context; legacy/unknown zero-input context cannot be used as a continuation anchor
